title: LYRA (organismic drone machine)
author: Arvid Solander (after SOMA Laboratory's LYRA-4; no SOMA code)
description: LYRA, a drone machine after SOMA's LYRA-4/8: four oscillators in two pairs (triangle to square, and DRIVE), cross-modulated (SELF, PAIR, HLFO, CHN, DLY, or the partner track: TRK), a HYPER LFO (two LFOs by SUM, AND, OR, XOR, S&H or a chaotic map) and its own delay network: FBK feeds the echoes back into the oscillators, DLY runs the loop away. The top half of SHRP, MOD, FBK, DLY and DMOD is nonlinear. Machine 90.
